surveys.name: Institutional Characteristics
surveys.reason: The governed institution profile supports review, but the official 2025-26 NCES public catalog exposes no IC import-file layout.

surveys.name: Completions
surveys.reason: Governed completion, student demographic, program, CIP, and award-level data are available.

surveys.name: 12-Month Enrollment
surveys.reason: The governed annual enrollment mart supplies unduplicated headcount, instructional activity, distance education, and dual-enrollment controls.

surveys.name: Cost
surveys.reason: Applicable institution-level tuition, fees, and cost-of-attendance fields are generated. Official Part F is not applicable because the institution has no doctor's-professional-practice program.

surveys.name: Admissions
surveys.reason: First-time and transfer admission sections are generated from an explicitly estimated admissions funnel derived from governed enrolled headcount.

surveys.name: Graduation Rates
surveys.reason: The governed graduation-rate cohort mart models the official exclusion categories and 150%-time completion outcomes.

surveys.name: 200% Graduation Rates
surveys.reason: The same governed graduation-rate cohort mart supplies official exclusions and 200%-time outcomes.

surveys.name: Outcome Measures
surveys.reason: Cohort, Pell/loan, award, and retained-at-institution outcomes are generated; transfer completion remains blocked on Clearinghouse data.

surveys.name: Student Financial Aid
surveys.reason: The governed financial-aid mart supplies enrollment controls, Pell recipients, federal loans, amounts, percentages, and averages.

surveys.name: Fall Enrollment
surveys.reason: Parts A, B, D, and H are source-derived from the Fall census. Parts C, E, F, and G are structurally generated from explicitly modeled demonstration controls and are not operational submission-ready data.

surveys.name: Finance
surveys.reason: A selected GASB control summary is generated; the complete official GASB statement and Census schedules remain blocked on audited general-ledger detail.

surveys.name: Human Resources
surveys.reason: Applicable employee census, occupation, tenure, demographic, graduate-assistant, salary, and new-hire sections are generated from the governed HR mart.

retired.name: Academic Libraries
retired.reason: NCES retired the Academic Libraries survey component beginning with the 2025-26 collection.
